summary: Preinstall alternate-runtime dropper executes bundled obfuscated payload via Bun
details: @onereach/si-collapsible-group@0.6.6 declares itself as a Vue UI collapsible-group component but ships a preinstall lifecycle hook (scripts.preinstall runs node setup.mjs) that downloads the Bun runtime (bun-v1.3.13) from GitHub releases, extracts and chmods it to 0o755, and then execFileSync's it against a shipped 727KB file math_init.js at install time. math_init.js is a heavily obfuscated bundle (rotated string-array shuffler WV8StW pushing/shifting a large numeric/char constant array, no readable identifiers) with no relationship to the advertised Vue component. Pulling a second language runtime specifically to execute an opaque bundled script bypasses Node-based auditing and dependency scanners and matches the alternate-runtime-dropper shape. The payload executes automatically on every npm install without user interaction.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
